CustomField.description: Date the lender commitment is due or was issued. PARITY FIELD: it feeds the Loan Commitment critical date, which Critical_Date__c.Type__c already carries as a valid value and which the critical-date rules already gate on Transaction__c.Loan_Required__c. Without it that critical date type has no source and can never be projected.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date the lender loan commitment is due. Feeds the Loan Commitment critical date on the deal.
CustomField.label: Commitment Date
